title: Q-PATCH-EDIT-WORKER: the tick Worker's code agent takes EDIT blocks and sees the files an item names
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/pr-executor.js::<<<EDIT
**Status:** open

PATCH-EDIT-1 gave the Actions executor find-and-replace edits (`foundation/agents.py` `apply_edit`, `parse_json`) and the text of the files an item names (`foundation/executor.py` `file_context`). The Worker route still asks for whole files and shows the model only file names: `buildPrompt` in `seed/worker/src/pr-executor.js` and the system message in `seed/worker/src/codeagent.js`. Port the same reply format (`<<<EDIT path>>>`, `<<<FIND>>>`, `<<<REPLACE>>>`, `<<<END>>>`) and the same exact-or-unambiguous placement rule to `seed/worker/src/pr-executor.js`, read each named file through the GitHub contents API before the model call, and add a test in `seed/worker/test/` that applies an edit to a fixture file.

size: M
